usageNote: 口语超常用！probably表示'大概'，比maybe更有把握一点点，适合聊未来不确定的事～

examples.en: Small bookstores will probably disappear sometime in the future.
examples.zh: 小书店将来某个时候可能会消失。

examples.en: This old tradition will probably disappear sometime in the future if we don't protect it.
examples.zh: 如果我们不保护，这个古老传统将来可能会消失。
